title: South African EGRA assessment content
description: Portable source transcription for Masi and Zazi iZandi. Content only; not an activation configuration or a validated scoring protocol.

conventions.itemOrder: Row-major: left to right, top to bottom. Preserve duplicates and case.
conventions.itemIdentity: IDs are one-based positions within each section. Persist assessment id, section name and item id together. Never identify a response by prompt text.
conventions.answerText: Source answer key or rubric for a human assessor; not an exact-match automatic scoring rule.
conventions.missingSourceCount: null means no count printed on the selected chart, not zero items.
conventions.textNormalization: PDF layout line wraps are joined, repeated layout whitespace is collapsed and extraction-only word splits repaired. Spelling, case and punctuation are retained. Paragraph breaks are represented as two newlines.
conventions.versioning: Do not change ordered content under an assessment id once responses refer to it; publish a new id/version.
conventions.administration: Time limits included for convenience. Full instructions, stop rules, benchmarks and scoring algorithms are not encoded; consult the linked source.
conventions.review: Source inconsistencies are recorded in sourceNotes. The catalog is importable content, not approval to replace existing field instruments.

assessments.title: isiXhosa EGRA 1

passage.text:
ULolo wayeza kuqala ukuya kwisikolo esikhulu. Lwalungathi alufiki olu suku yimivuyo.

Ngomhla wokuvulwa kwezikolo wavuka ekuseni. Wahlamba waza watya isidlo sakusasa. Emva koko uLolo wabeleka ubhaka wakhe waya esikolweni nomama wakhe.

Esikolweni waboniswa utitshalakazi wakhe. Utitshalakazi wabalisa ibali likaSidumo. USidumo libali elidlala kumabonakude. ULolo wahleka izinto ezenziwa nguSidumo Wabona ukuba kumnandi esikolweni esikhulu.

questions.text: Ngubani owayeza kuya esikolweni?
Wavuka nini ngosuku lokuvulwa kwezikolo?
Waya nabani esikolweni?
Wenza ntoni utitshalakazi wabo?
questions.answerText: wababalisela ibali okanye wabalisa ibali likaSidumo

questions.text: Ingaba wabona ngathi kumnandi na esikolweni uLolo?

sourceNotes: Questions follow the learner chart; answers follow the corresponding teacher-guide key. Minor wording differences between the two sources are preserved.

The source omits punctuation between nguSidumo and Wabona; it is preserved. The answer to question 4 ends with an unmatched closing quote in the guide; it is preserved.

assessments.title: isiXhosa EGRA 2

passage.text:
Kwakukho utata owayefuna umsebenzi. Wavuka ekuseni wayakufuna umsebenzi emzini wesityebi. Wahamba, wahamba wada wafika emzini wesityebi.

Esi sityebi sasinomzi omkhulu. Wafika lo tata wema phambi kwendlu waza wathi ucela umsebenzi.

Isityebi sambuza utata ukuba ingaba ufuna msebenzi mni na. Wathi ke yena ufuna nokuba ngonjani na, angazityisa neehagu.

Isityebi ke samxelela ukuba umsebenzi esinawo ngowokwalusa iibhokhwe ezininzi kakhulu. Kufuneka azijonge zingayi endleleni. Wavuma ngovuyo olukhulu lo mfo.

questions.text: Lingantoni eli bali?
Ngoobani ekuthethwa ngabo kweli bali?
Wathini utata akufika emzini wesityebi?
Yaba ngumsebenzi wantoni?
Kwenzeka ntoni akuba efumene umsebenzi utata?

assessments.title: isiXhosa EGRA 3

passage.text:
Kudala dala kwakukho ixhegokazi elalikhohlakele kakhulu. Igama lalo yayinguNomehlo-mancinane. Yayilizim elalizenza umntu onobubele. Izim ngumntu otya abantu.

UNomehlo-mancinane wayenentombi ewayeyithanda kakhulu. Wayenodadewabo owayehlala kwenye ilali. UNomehlo-mancinane wayengamthandi kakhulu udadewabo. Udade lo wayeneentombi ezintathu. Ngenye imini ezi ntombi zandwendwela uNomehlo- mancinane.

Zazingamazi ukuba ulizim. Zathi xa zisendleleni zadibana nomnye umama owazixelela ukuba umakazi wabo lizim. Zagqiba kwelokuba maziye phambili zingoyiki, ziyombona umakazi.

questions.text: Ngubani igama lexhegokazi obufunda ngalo?
Yintoni izim?
Ucinga ukuba kulungile ukuba lizim?
Utsho ngoba?
Zazingaphi iintombi zakadade boNomehlomancinane?

assessments.title: English HL EGRA 1

passage.text:
Jabu had a little dog. The little dog was fat and happy. One day Jabu and the dog went out to play in the fields behind his house.

The little dog liked to play tricks and he ran away. The little dog got lost. Jabu was sad. But after a while the dog came back. He had been gone for only a little while.

Jabu took the dog home. When they got home Jabu gave the dog a bone. The dog ate it.

The little dog was happy, so he slept. Jabu also went to sleep. They both slept for a very long time and played again when they woke up.

questions.text: Who had a dog?
Was the dog big or little?
What did the dog like to do?
Where did Jabu take the dog?
What did the dog do after he got the bone?

sourceNotes: Question 5 uses the assessment-page answer key; the earlier worked example also accepts He slept.

assessments.title: English HL EGRA 2

passage.text:
Everyone was in the playground at the school. It was after the holidays. The children were playing with their toys. Nomsa had brought a plastic snake along. She had bought it while on holiday with her parents.

Mrs May, their teacher, called everyone inside. Anne liked to play tricks. Anne had an idea. She wanted to play a trick on Mrs May.

Anne cried out that she could see a snake in the playground. Sipho said he could see it too. Ben asked what kind of snake it was. Mrs May told them it was a black adder. Anne smiled. She said it was only a plastic snake.

After Anne had played her trick, all the children started reading their interesting story books.

questions.text: Who had bought the snake?
What was the snake made of?
Who had an idea?
What kind of snake was it?
Why did Anne want to trick the teacher?

sourceNotes: Passage printed total is 122; whitespace token count is 123. Neither is silently substituted for the other; verify the scoring denominator before use.

passage.text:
Once there was a giant called Nunu. He was big and ugly. He also liked to eat people. One day he saw a clever and brave girl called Lulu. He caught her. Lulu was very scared. He wanted to eat her, but Lulu was too clever for the giant.

Lulu told the giant that she would taste better with salt. The giant put Lulu in his bag. He left the bag on the field. Then he went to get the salt from his house.

Lulu got out of the bag and ran home to her family.

When the giant came back he found that the bag was empty. He was angry and went to bed hungry that night.

Lulu was happy, but the giant was disappointed.

questions.text: What was the giant’s name?
What did he like to do?
Where did the giant put the girl?
What did the girl do after the giant had gone to his house?
questions.answerText: Accept any one of these answers: got out of the bag, ran home

questions.text: Why do you think the giant was disappointed?

passage.text: Sam and Jill go to school by bus. The bus is red. They take their bags on the bus. The bus stops. What now? Sam looks at Jill. The bus stops for the old man and his dog. The man and his dog get on the bus. They also want to go to school.

questions.text: Who goes to school?
What colour is the bus?
What do they take with them?
Who got on the bus?
Where do they want to go?

assessments.title: English FAL EGRA 2

passage.text: Mpho goes to the farm to visit his friend, Buhle. The boys like to help to feed the animals. They give the hens food and water. They run to the dam to see the ducks. Then Buhle falls into the dam with a big splash. Help me! Help me! He screams. Mpho jumps in and pulls Buhle from the water. They are both very wet. The boys sit in the sun until they are dry.

questions.text: Who is Mpho’s friend?
Where does his friend live?
Why do the boys go to the dam?
What happened to Buhle?
Why do the boys sit in the sun?

assessments.title: English FAL EGRA 3

passage.text: Lebo is very excited. It is her birthday. She is eight years old. She wants a bike. Dad gives her a surprise on her birthday. He hides her gift in the garden. She hears Dad singing in the garden. Happy birthday! my dear Lebo . She looks behind the big tree and sees Dad with the bike. He gives her a big smile. Lebo is so happy and she shouts with joy. “Is this bike for me! Dad?” Yes! It is your gift Lebo. Thank you very much, Dad. Now I will ride my new bike to school.

questions.text: What does Lebo want for her birthday?
How old is Lebo?
Where did she find her gift?
Why did her dad hide the bike?
Why do you think Lebo wanted a bike?

passage.text:
Jan het ’n hond. Die hond is klein en vet. Eendag gaan Jan en die hond buite speel.

Die hond raak weg, maar na ’n rukkie kom hy weer terug.

Jan neem die hond huis toe. By die huis gee Jan die hond ’n groot been. Die hond is baie gelukkig en raak gou aan die slaap. Jan gaan ook slaap. Hulle slaap lekker.

questions.text: Wie het ’n hond?
Was die hond groot of klein?
Was die hond vet of maer?
Waarheen het Jan die hond geneem?
questions.answerText: Aanvaar ‘om buite te speel’ of ‘huis toe geneem’

questions.text: Wat het die hond gedoen nadat hy die been gekry het?

assessments.title: Afrikaans EGRA 2

passage.text:
Thandi woon op ’n plaas. Daar is nie water in die huise op die plaas nie.

Sy weet die huise in die dorp het elkeen ’n kraan. Een kraan se water is warm en een kraan se water is koud. Jy maak net die kraan oop, dan spoeg dit die water uit. Jy kan ’n bad vol water tap. Mens hoef glad nie die water aan te dra nie.

Daar is nie ’n bad op die plaas nie. Almal bad sommer in die dam.

Thandi sit die emmer water voor die deur neer. Mamma gaan ’n lepel Jik in die water gooi. Sy gaan die water kook om pap te maak. Sy gaan ook daarmee vir hulle tee maak.

questions.text: Waar woon Thandi?
Is daar ’n kraan in Thandi se huis?
Waar bad almal op die plaas?
Wat gooi Mamma in die water?
Wat gaan Mamma met die water maak?
questions.answerText: Sy kook die water om pap en tee te maak.

sourceNotes: Letter chart is labelled 60 letterklanke but visibly contains 7 rows of 10 (70). All 70 entries are retained.

assessments.title: Afrikaans EGRA 3

passage.text:
Vusi gooi ’n plat klip op die water en kyk hoe dit een, twee, drie, vier keer spring. Hy voel alleen, want sy vriend Thami, is in die skool. Vusi voel hartseer, want hy wil ook graag skool toe gaan.

Sy ouma leer hom elke dag om te lees en skryf, maar dit is nie genoeg nie. Hy wil nog meer leer.

Sy oupa wil nie he Vusi moet skool toe gaan nie. Hy moet by die huis bly om hom te help met al die werkies. Vusi is baie fluks.

Die aand huil Vusi hom aan die slaap. Hy wil so graag skool toe gaan. Al sy maats is in die skool. Hoekom moet hy dan by die huis bly?

Die volgende oggend maak sy ouma hom wakker met goeie nuus. Hy mag skool toe gaan!

questions.text: Hoeveel keer spring die plat klip op die water?
Hoekom voel Vusi hartseer?
questions.answerText: Hy wil ook graag skool toe gaan.

questions.text: Wat leer sy ouma elke dag vir hom?
questions.answerText: Sy leer hom om te lees en te skryf.

questions.text: Hoekom wil oupa nie he Vusi moet skool toe gaan nie?
questions.answerText: Vusi moet help met al die werkies by die huis.

questions.text: Watter goeie nuus het ouma vir Vusi gehad?

sourceNotes: Source spells he without a circumflex in the passage and question 4; preserved as printed.

assessments.title: isiZulu SMRS EGRA 1

passage.text:
Igama lami nginguJabu. Ngineminyaka eyisithupa. Ngithanda ukusiza usisi uma egeza izitsha. Usisi engitshela ukuthi kubalulekile ukusizana, kanye nokuhlanzeka.

Abanye abafana bacabanga ukuthi amantombazane kuphela okufanele ageze izitsha, kanti akunjalo. Umama wangitshela ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele azigeze izitsha. Ngiyathanda ukulekelela usisi uma egeza izitsha.

questions.text: Ngubani igama lomfana?
Uneminyaka emingaki umfana?
Ngabe uthanda ukwenzani umfana?
Umama wamtshela ukuthi yini ebalulekile?
Ucabanga ukuthi usisi uzizwa enjani uma uJabu emsiza?

sourceNotes: The source question 4 attributes a statement to Umama, whereas the corresponding passage sentence names Usisi. Both are preserved; review before operational use.
